transcript:
Sleep pressure builds with time awake. Body-clock timing also helps organise sleepiness and wakefulness. The processes interact.

People differ in their timing and opportunities to sleep. Choose a practical routine around your actual rest period.

Hours are part of the picture. How you function during the day also matters. A selected duration does not measure sleep quality.

Persistent difficulties deserve assessment. General sleep tips are not the same as structured treatment for insomnia. Do not drive when sleepy.
